purpose: Place the new R2 Hub, Airband and analog-FPV bodies in the accepted 75 x 150 mm two-board coordinate system before any R2 KiCad work.

policy.coordinates: world X/Y from the accepted assembly-coordinate model; RF-inner drawing is mirrored only for the viewer
policy.base_geometry: R1 bodies are retained only as a collision-tested placement seed and may move during complete R2 optimisation
policy.fixed_body: one exact serial device per rectangle
policy.reserve: a dashed physical allocation, never a component or accepted MPN
policy.silkscreen: none of the inner-face annotations in the generated engineering drawing are PCB silkscreen
policy.antenna_identification: Every outward RF port keeps a readable role/band label and gains a compact kit code. A post-assembly colour collar around the connector base and a durable heat-shrink flag on the matching antenna repeat that code; colour is redundant and is never the sole identifier.
